messages:
cara (Marketing PM): hey @sam and team — we need a small design push for the Redwood benchmark launch and webinar next week (Wed). Deliverables: hero blog image, 3 social carousel frames, architecture/serving diagram (SVG), a performance chart export (PNG + raw CSV), and a 16:9 slide deck template that follows brand. Also need a short checklist for exports and brand compliance signoff. Can you confirm owners and ETA? Goal: publish blog + social on Wed 05/29, webinar same day PM.
sam (Designer): taking this. quick q — do we want the performance chart as stacked bars or a line chart? and is there a canonical color for the latency vs cost lines?
juan (Growth): stacked bars for latency / cost comparisons work best for social. throughput can be a line overlay. use the primary teal for Redwood throughput and secondary slate for cost.
li (Product Marketing): make sure the copy distinguishes Hosted vs Dedicated (capitalization: "Redwood Hosted" / "Redwood Dedicated"). also include a tiny callout: "Measured on public open model X with 2x batching" — we’ll finalize numbers but keep space.
sam (Designer): noted. tentative ETA: draft frames + figma link by Tue EOD. Will create: hero 1200x628 PNG, carousel 1080x1080 PNGs x3, diagram as SVG, chart PNG at 1200x720 plus CSV. Figma page: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE_REDL/benchmarks (will update).
cara (Marketing PM): thanks. can you paste a quick export spec block so ops knows what to expect for image sizes and fonts?
sam (Designer): sure — export specs:
```
Hero: 1200x628 px, PNG, 72dpi, sRGB
Social carousel: 1080x1080 px, PNG/JPEG high quality
Diagram: SVG vector (editable), fonts outlined (Redwood Sans)
Chart: 1200x720 px PNG + raw CSV (comma) + Vega-lite JSON (if available)
Slides: 16:9 Google Slides + Keynote template, include master slide and 4 layout variants
All files: filename prefix: rdw-benchmark-<asset>-v1
Color tokens: --rdw-primary: #00A3B8 (throughput teal), --rdw-neutral-700: #2D3940
Fonts: Redwood Sans (heading), Redwood Text (body); fallback: Inter
Brand check: include logo safe-zone, 24px margin min
```
nina (Legal): I’ll review any comparative language tomorrow morning. flagging: avoid absolute claims like "50% cheaper" unless backed by verifiable methodology. Prefer "up to" or "typical" phrasing until we finalize the benchmark doc.
sam (Designer): noted — will add an annotation layer in Figma with callouts for any wording that needs signoff.
design-bot: Figma frames created by sam: figma.com/file/EXAMPLE_REDL/benchmarks?node-id=42 — 9 frames (hero, carousel x3, diagram, chart, slides x3).
cara (Marketing PM): perfect. can we also get one simple explainer diagram that highlights caching + routing benefits (single-slide visual)? that's high priority for webinar slides.
sam (Designer): yes — adding a dedicated slide for "Smart routing & caching". ETA still Tue EOD for first pass, Wed morning final if needed.
juan (Growth): I'll prep the short benchmarks narrative and a 2-sentence social hook so copy can slot into the hero image.
li (Product Marketing): i'll sync with data science this afternoon to lock the numbers and send the CSV.
nina (Legal): will review copy by Tue noon.
cara (Marketing PM): awesome — final ask: please post Figma link here when frames are ready and drop a short checklist for export so ops can stage assets for the CMS. Thanks! :rocket:
sam (Designer): will do — checklist below and i’ll ping when uploaded:
- Upload figma frames + share link
- Export hero + carousel PNGs at specified sizes
- Export SVG diagram + outline fonts
- Export chart PNG + attach CSV & Vega-lite JSON
- Create slides package (Google Slides link + .pptx)
- Tag files with rdw-benchmark-v1 prefix
- Add legal annotation layer
- Add readme.txt with usage notes and alt text for accessibility
I'll post the figma link here when done.
cara (Marketing PM): copied. thanks everyone — feeling good about this. :thumbsup:
